about: I'm a Software Engineer based in Denver, Colorado, where I've found the perfect balance between my passion for technology and love for the outdoors. With 3.5 years of professional experience building enterprise applications and data pipelines, I'm currently exploring personal projects and looking for my next role where I can continue to grow as an engineer. This website is my space to share my outdoor adventures. I hope you enjoy the content and please feel free to reach out with any interest or questions!
